    // One apex per face; one triangle per corner.
    Kis(self: PolygonMesh3D, height: Number): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMeshOfFaces(
            Concatenate(self.Positions, self.FaceApexPoints(height)),
            self.CornerCount.MapRange(c => self.KisFaceOfCorner(CornerIndex(c))));
